We use necessary cookies to make our site work.

We’d like to set analytics and marketing cookies to understand how you use our website to improve it.

We also use cookies set by other sites to help us deliver content from their services.

You can read more about our cookies before you choose.

Read more about our cookies

These cookies are essential for you to browse the website and use its features, such as the eligibility tool and setting your cookie preferences.
Cookies that assist in delivering a better experience for users by understanding how the website is being used.
Cookies that track visitors across websites to display more relevant and engaging ads, benefiting users, publishers, and advertisers.
We use a number of Third Party services to provide an enhanced user experience. These services include third party content, such as videos from Youtube.

How can we help you today?
Search to access services, pay bills, report issues, and more
Ennis Town Bus Service

Information regarding Ennis Town Bus service, operating from Sunday October 18.
Online services
Apply
Pay
Tell us about it
Find it

Services

Council

Information about the council governance and structure, municipal districts and electoral registers.

Housing

Our housing services help citizens find secure, cost effective, quality accommodation and housing support for people in need.

Planning and building

Find out about planning permission, development plans, protecting our heritage, building control and more.

Roads, parking and travel

We advance public and transportation safety and manage Clare's road network to best and fairly serve all users.

Environment, water and waste

Learn about waste and recycling, water and wastewater, environmental monitoring and protecting the environment.

Arts, culture and libraries

Discover our range of services for all ages at our public libraries. Find out about our Arts Service and our work with artists and communities.

Business, licensing and economy

Assistance and supports for enterprise, business and investment; paying rates and applying for licenses and other topics.

Climate action

Find out how we are advancing climate action and supporting local communities.

Emergency services

Find out about fire prevention, firefighting and rescue services, community fire safety, and major emergency planning.

Sports, recreation and healthy living

Our sports, recreation, and healthy living services help people stay active, connect with others, and enjoy a healthier lifestyle.

Tourism development

Find out about tourism development and promotion and our vision for Clare to be a globally-renowned sustainable and vibrant destination.

Towns - enhancement, regeneration and plans

We are implementing town regeneration plans under the Town Centre First Policy, including projects for Ennis, Shannon, and Killaloe. These initiatives focus on reducing vacancy, improving public spaces, and creating sustainable development.

Heritage and biodiversity

County Clare's heritage tells the story of how people and the environment have changed over time and its biodiversity shows the variety of plants and animals that make the area special.

Rural and community development

Supporting the growth of towns and villages in County Clare and working in partnership with community groups and other key stakeholders

Integration

We support people seeking international protection, refugees, and others as they settle into Irish life, helping them connect with local services and become active members of their new communities.

News

All News

Careers in the Council

Working for Clare County Council will give you the opportunity to gain experience at the heart of local government and to make a real difference to our county and we seek to attract and retain talented and motivated people, from diverse backgrounds and experiences. 
Find out more
Spotlights
https://visitclare.ie/
Visit Clare
Open spaces, amazing places, friendly faces
Biodiversity
County Clare is home to some of the most special and valuable habitats, species and biodiversity in Ireland. We need only to look out our own windows to see birds soaring in the sky and bees buzzing around the flowers in our gardens, all of which bring joy to our hearts.
Clare Libraries
Discover services at our libraries - a sensory pod, laptops and tablets to borrow, quiet pods, Local studies, genealogy and archives and art galleries
Clare Arts Office
Creative people, places and projects…

This is a platform where Clare County Council and the community can come together to discuss important projects, share visions and contribute to making Clare a great place to live, work and visit.

Welcome to Clare Alerts - Clare County Council's free alert service for people living and working in County Clare. This service gives you quick information for specific events that may affect you. This may include day-to-day events such as road works or other isolated events such as severe weather emergencies.

About

 

Cookies are small text files that can be used by websites to make a user's experience more efficient.

 

The law states that we can store cookies on your device if they are strictly necessary for the operation of this site. For all other types of cookies we need your permission.

 

This site uses different types of cookies. Some cookies are placed by third party services that appear on our pages.

 

You can at any time change or withdraw your consent from the Cookie Declaration on our website.

 

Learn more about who we are, how you can contact us and how we process personal data in our Privacy Policy.

 

Please state your consent ID and date when you contact us regarding your consent.

Welcome to the Royal Borough of Kingston

Active Kingston

Homepage - services panel

Our services

Council Tax

Pay your Council Tax, view your bill, manage your account, report a change and find out about discounts.

Bins and recycling

Check your bin collection day, report a missed bin collection, book a recycling centre visit, order a bulky rubbish collection and get a garden waste subscription.

Parking

Find out how to pay for parking, find where to park, buy parking permits and visitor vouchers, and pay or appeal a parking fine (PCN).

Roads and travel

Find roadworks and closures, report road problems, view and comment on open Traffic Management Orders (TMOs) and find out about accessible travel and greener travel options.

Planning and Building Control

Check if you need planning permission or Building Control approval, search or comment on a planning application and find out about heritage, conservation and regeneration plans.

Housing

Get support and advice on finding a home, manage your council tenancy, learn about rights and responsibilities as a tenant or leaseholder, get help with homelessness, and get support if you're new to the UK.

Environmental health and public issues

Report a noise or garden nuisance, report damp and mould, check a food business's hygiene rating, request a street clean, report a tree issue, get flooding advice and more.

Births, deaths and ceremonies

Find out how to register a birth or a death, give notice of a marriage or civil partnership, find ceremony venues, order certificates and find information about citizenship ceremonies.

Leisure and community

Find a local event, search for parks and play areas, find your nearest leisure centre, visit your local library or museum, find volunteering opportunities and find out how to get involved your community.

Benefits and support

Apply for a Council Tax reduction or Housing Benefit, find out about the Household Support Fund, get help with managing money, and report benefit fraud.

Care and support for adults

Services from adult social care and our partners to help you stay independent, safe and well.

Children, young people and families

Report a concern about a child or young person, find out about fostering and adoption and find the SEND Local Offer. Our children's services are provided by Achieving for Children.

Schools and learning

Apply for school places, find term dates, apply for free school meals, find out about music lessons and find courses for adults. Our children's services are provided by Achieving for Children.

Your council

Find a councillor, get information about elections and voting, find out how we make decisions, view our annual budget, make a comment or complaint, explore council jobs, and find privacy information.

Business and licensing

Find resources for running a business, including information about rates, licensing, food business registration, business premises, doing business with the Council, and economic initiatives.

Health and wellbeing

Find out how to look after your and your family's health, and get support with children’s health, information about mental health, dementia, sexual health, drug and alcohol problems, weight loss and stopping smoking.

Safety, crime and emergencies

Find guidance on reporting a crime or antisocial behaviour, find domestic and sexual violence support, get advice on staying safe online and find advice on local safety issues.

Climate and sustainability

Find out about our Climate Action Strategy, get involved in the Kingston Green Business Community forum, and find out about saving energy and money at home.

26 October 2026

Planning approval secured for Phase 2 of Cambridge Road Estate regeneration

Kingston Council and its regeneration partner, Countryside Partnerships (part of the Vistry Group), have secured planning permission for the next phase of the Cambridge Road Estate regeneration, bringing forward new council homes, greener public spaces and more places for residents to meet and play.

23 October 2026

Former councillors awarded title of Honorary Alderman for exceptional service

Long-serving former councillors Liz Green and Diane White have been awarded the prestigious title of Honorary Alderman in recognition of their outstanding dedication to the Royal Borough of Kingston.

14 October 2026

Standing united against hate

This National Hate Crime Awareness Week, Kingston Council is reaffirming its commitment to tackling all forms of discrimination and hate across the borough.

Cookies on the Erewash Borough Council website

We've put some small files called cookies on your device to make our site work. These are called necessary cookies. We'd also like to use analytics cookies. These send information about how our site is used to a service called Google Analytics and Hotjar. We use this information to improve our site. Let us know if this is OK. We'll use a cookie to save your choice. You can read more about our cookies before you choose.

Welcome to Erewash Borough Council

Homepage action panel - campaigns

Pride in Place Cotmanhay

Bringing residents, groups, businesses and partners together to improve the area and create lasting change.

Flooding

Prepare for flooding: Sign up for flood alerts, check your flood risk and find the latest weather alerts.

Long Eaton Town Deal

Find out about the projects that form the Long Eaton Town Deal.
Homepage - services panel

Popular Services

Council Tax

Pay council tax, information on bands and how to get support.

Bins and Recycling

Bins, bulky waste collections, recycling centres, clinical waste, business, trade and commercial waste, how to reduce waste and reuse.

Planning

Search planning applications and find out about how to apply for planning permission.

Building Control

Building control services for Erewash, Ashfield District Council, Broxtowe Borough Council, Gedling Borough Council and Mansfield District Council.

Benefits and Financial Support

Benefits help and advice, including Housing Benefit, Council Tax Support and emergency support.

Your Council

Information about elections, councillors, reports, policies and plans.

Businesses and Licensing

Support for businesses, business rates information and licensing information for taxi drivers and establishments that sell alcohol.

Community Support

Find out about health and wellbeing support, community grants and get help with the cost of living.

Housing

Housing support, homelessness services and information for landlords.

Environmental Issues

Information on air quality, litter enforcement, climate change, noise and nuisances and fly-tipping.

Safer Communities

Information on ASB, crime prevention, support services and the Safer Erewash Partnership.

Your Borough

Erewash's green spaces, parks, car parks events and Erewash Museum.
Homepage action panel - 2

Do it Online and Smart Form

Access of Smart Form to see all our online services in one place.

Pay for it

Pay your council tax, subscribe for a garden waste subscription, book and pay for a bulky waste collection and other council services.

Car Parks

Where to park in Erewash. Find where all of the council's car parks are in the borough and how many spaces there are.

Latest News

06 November 2026
Erewash to again be a beacon of Remembrance
Residents across Erewash are being encouraged to join the thousands who each year turn the borough into a beacon of remembrance – following the unveiling of a huge mural depicting much-loved local war hero Donald Rose.
06 November 2026
New survey over plans for towns to get own councils
Letters are being sent to residents in parts of Erewash inviting them to give their views as part of the borough council's Community Governance Review.
05 November 2026
Last chance to put your brown bin out this year is coming up
Residents who get their garden waste taken away by the council are reminded that November is when the bin scheme begins its pause over the winter.
05 November 2026
Boxing club’s Scarlett, 15 is its first national champ
A schoolgirl boxing sensation has clinched featherweight glory as the first national champion of an Erewash fight academy that was launched to get youngsters active and socialising again after the pandemic lockdowns.
03 November 2026
Lenny is 11th hr star guest at Windrush gala
A glittering event that each year invites a top Black celebrity to help celebrate how Windrush generation families were made welcome in Erewash saw Sir Lenny Henry step in at the last minute after TV’s Judi Love could not make it.

6 November 2026

Cahill Craft Appointed as Main Contractor for Community and Enterprise Hub

Construction has officially commenced on The Sorting House, Borris, marking a major milestone in the transformation of the town's former Post Office into a vibrant new community and enterprise hub.

4 November 2026

Carlow County Council Launches Jinglefest 2026

Carlow County Council is delighted to announce the launch of Jinglefest 2026, an exciting new county-wide Christmas programme that will bring festive fun, family experiences, live entertainment and laughter to communities across Carlow this holiday season.

4 November 2026

Inaugural Big Barn Bash Attracts More Than 1,000 Visitors to Celebrate Food, Farming, Family Fun and Community Spirit

The inaugural Big Barn Bash has been hailed a tremendous success after attracting more than 1,000 visitors to Coppenagh House Farm, Tullow, for a weekend that celebrated the very best of County Carlow's food, farming, rural enterprise and community spirit. The first-ever festival combined live entertainment, family activities, artisan food and drink experiences and the hugely successful Coopenagh Coo 5km, creating a unique event that brought together visitors from across Carlow and beyond.

4 November 2026

Fabric of Change Carlow Showcases the Power of Circular Fashion

Fabric of Change Carlow transformed a vacant town-centre space into a vibrant hub of sustainable fashion during Climate Action Week 2026, inspiring residents to embrace repair, reuse and circular fashion. Through creative workshops, clothing swaps, community engagement and skills training, the initiative demonstrated how local action and strong partnerships can reduce textile waste, build practical sustainability skills and support a more circular future for Carlow.

3 November 2026

Pan Celtic National Song Contest 2027 Secures New Lead Sponsor

Kilkenny and Carlow ETB/Education and Training Board Announced as Official Partner of Pan Celtic Festival 2027

The Pan Celtic Association has announced exciting details of the Pan Celtic National Song Contest 2027, including the appointment of a major new sponsor for one of Ireland's most prestigious Irish-language music competitions.

23 October 2026

Bagenalstown Set to Become Carlow's Active Travel Success Story

€1,000,000 Investment Delivers Safer Routes to School for Hundreds of Families

Bagenalstown is fast becoming a leading example of how Active Travel investment can transform a town, with the official launch today of two major Safe Routes to School projects at Queen of the Universe National School and St. Brigid's National School.

Jinglefest Comedy Shows Launches Spectacular Four-Day Comedy Festival for Carlow This December

Karl Spain launches Jinglefest Comedy Shows at The Barracks as tickets go on sale for a weekend packed with laughter, live entertainment and fundraising events.

Comedy fans across Carlow and beyond are being encouraged to book early as Jinglefest Comedy Shows 2026 officially launches a packed programme of performances taking place from 3rd to 6th December 2026 as part of Jinglefest, Carlow's Christmas Festival.

County Carlow Chamber Joins Partnership for Club Carlow Business Summit: Breaking the Ceiling in Sport and Business

This year’s theme is about empowering people in the community to look after themselves and others.

7 October 2026

Top Chefs, Local Flavours and Food Conversations Set to Take Centre Stage at Big Barn Bash

Rachel Allen, Edward Hayden and leading Carlow chefs join a packed Food & Drink Experience at Coppenagh House Farm, Tullow, this October Bank Holiday weekend

Food lovers and families are in for a treat this October Bank Holiday weekend as the Big Barn Bash brings together some of Ireland’s best-known chefs, leading local culinary talent, food and drink producers, farmers and industry experts for two action-packed days at Coppenagh House Farm, Tullow, on Saturday 31 October and Sunday 1 November 2026.

Apply

Pay

My RBWM

Our services

Adult social care

Information about safeguarding, mental health, social work teams, learning disability service, paying for your care and support and more.

Business and economy

Business rates, licensing, trading standards, property company and regeneration.

Children and families

Achieving for Children (AfC) provides children's services for the Royal Borough of Windsor and Maidenhead.

Community and living

Registrars, public health, community support, garden in bloom, domestic abuse, armed forces, civic events and more.

Council and democracy

Elections and voting, council committees and meetings, policies, plans and strategies and much more.

Council tax and benefits

Pay your council tax, changes in your circumstances, help and guidance, which includes housing benefit and council tax support.

Environment and waste

Rubbish and recycling, reporting environmental problems, environment health, energy and sustainability, pest control and nature and conservation.

Housing

Information on homeowners and landlords, homelessness, housing support, private tenants, homes in multiple occupation and more.

Jobs and careers

Information on current vacancies' at RBWM, benefits of working for us and information on skills and careers advice.

Leisure and culture

Information on our parks, libraries advantage card, sports and leisure, filming in the borough, museum and the Guildhall.

Planning and building control

Planning, building control, tree management, weekly lists, local land charges, find an application and more.

Schools and Education

School admissions, school transport, term dates, employment of children, school governors, school admission appeals and more.

Transport and streets

Information on car parks, permits, rights of way, public transport, winter services, highways, report issues on streets, littering and more.

Know your neighbourhood

Find information about a specified property and/or map based information.

Fostering

Become a foster carer with the Royal Borough and make a difference for a local child in your community.

Cost of living support

If you are struggling financially and having to make difficult decisions – help is available.

AskSARA

Use our online tool to access equipment and advice that can help make daily living easier.

Community information hub

You can view or add events, clubs and organisations.

News

04 Nov 2026

More care leavers will be able to live locally as new step-down accommodation opens in the Royal Borough

More young people leaving care will be able to stay close to their local support networks following the opening of a new supported accommodation scheme in the Royal Borough. The facility provides high-quality accommodation and tailored support to help care leavers make a successful transition to independent living, while expanding the borough's local housing provision for young people.

03 Nov 2026

Next wave of Royal Borough play parks set for transformation

Families across the Royal Borough are set to enjoy three newly transformed playgrounds, with the upgrades bringing exciting, modern and inclusive play opportunities for children of all ages and abilities.

02 Nov 2026

Royal Borough launches new roadshow to help residents live well and access local support

Residents across the Royal Borough will soon be able to access advice, support and community opportunities closer to home through a new community roadshow launching in November.

29 Oct 2026

Government announces plans to progress with a mayoral strategic authority for the Thames Valley

Ambitions from council leaders across the Thames Valley to unlock economic, infrastructure and investment opportunities for the region are closer to being realised following the government’s announcement that the area has been placed on its programme for the creation of a new mayoral strategic authority (MSA).

Cookies on northumberland.gov.uk

We use cookies to store your preferences and enhance usability on the Northumberland County Council website.
Necessary Cookies (Always on)
These cookies are essential for the site to work properly. They enable basic functions like security, accessibility, and remembering your cookie preferences.
Cookies that measure website use
We use Google Analytics to measure how you use the website so we can improve it based on user needs. We do not allow Google to use or share the data.
Cookies that remember your settings
These cookies store your preferences, such as language and accessibility settings, so we can personalize your experience.

Many Ways to Pay for Parking

There are now several easy ways to pay for parking in Galway City. 

Choose the option that suits you best:

  • App: download the Galway City Parking app (Android and iPhone).
  • Website: pay at www.GalwayCityParking.ie
  • Phone: call our parking payment lines - (091) 894 300
  • In-store (cash or card): pay at any Payzone retail store – look for the pink Payzone logo, view a list of Payzone retailers in Galway City, or view the map of Payzone locations in Galway City.

Merlin Woods Restoration

Galway City Council is advancing plans to replant Merlin Woods as a native woodland, creating a more resilient habitat and community amenity following the extensive damage caused by Storm Eowyn in January 2025.

Since March 2026 the Council have engaged and listened to multiple stakeholders when planning the Merlin Woods Restoration Project. Based on the outcome of some of those engagements, three different types of expert advice were sought; ecological, arboricultural, and zoological. This evidence was carefully balanced against public safety, future community access and ecological considerations, leading to the decision to fell the identified woodland area.

EUI-IA WATERWAY Project

Welcome to the official information page for the WATERWAY Project, hosted by Galway City Council. This page provides key details about the European Urban Initiative (EUI) Innovative Actions (IA) project, "Water And Tourism Energy Resources for a Winning Active Galway" (WATERWAY).

Public Participation: Identification of Bathing Waters

Local authorities must identify official bathing areas in their area every year so that they can be monitored for safety, water quality and their level of use.  To help with this process, Galway City Council are asking people who swim at beaches, lakes and rivers to tell them if they think they should maintain existing designated bathing waters designations or give a new official bathing area designation to areas that are commonly used for swimming, but not identified at the moment.

Galway City Council is aware of a planned demonstration concerning the regulation of short-term letting accommodation and acknowledges the right of individuals and groups to peacefully express their views.

The Council considers it important to clarify the role of local authorities in relation to short-term letting regulations and recent legislative changes

TEMPORARY CLOSING OF ROADS Roads Act 1993 - Section 75 Roads Regulations 1994 - Article 12 Notice of Intention - Woodquay

4 November 2026

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that Galway City Council proposes to make an order closing:

Woodquay: From St Anthony’s Place To Court Lane.

.gw-launchpad-icon-fill {
  fill: black;
  fill: var(--iconFillColor, var(--iconFillColor));
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: 10px;
  height: 3.5em;
  width: 3.5em;
  border-radius: 35px;
  padding: 0.4em;
  margin: 0;
  border: 2px solid var(--transparent);
  background-color: rgba(220, 223, 228, 0.5);
  background-color: var(--iconButtonBackgroundDefaultColor, var(--icon-button-background-default-color));
  /** Mobile icon Buttons
      ---------------------------------------------------------*/
  /** ---- **/
  /** Icon Button Size Three
  ---------------------------------------------------------*/
  /** Mobile Floating Button
      ---------------------------------------------------------*/
  /** Mobile Square Button
      ---------------------------------------------------------*/
  /** Mobile & Launchpad Floating Action Button Colours
      ---------------------------------------------------------*/
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button--icon {
  color: white;
  background-color: transparent;
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  fill: black;
  fill: var(--toolbarIconButtonFillColor, var(--fontColorDark));
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button--icon:disabled,
.gw-launchpad-icon-button--icon[disabled] {
  background-color: var(--transparent);
  border-color: var(--transparent);
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button--icon:visited {
  color: var(--fontColorDark);
  text-decoration: none;
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button--icon:hover {
  color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  border: var(--iconButtonBackgroundDefaultColor, var(--icon-button-border-color));
  background-color: rgba(220, 223, 228, 0.5);
  background-color: var(--iconButtonBackgroundHoverColor, var(--icon-button-background-hover-color));
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button--icon:hover,
.gw-launchpad-icon-button--icon:focus {
  text-decoration: none;
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button--icon:active {
  color: var(--fontColorDark, black);
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  border: var(--icon-button-border-color, var(--icon-button-background-hover-color));
  background-color: rgba(220, 223, 228, 0.5);
  background-color: var(--iconButtonBackgroundActiveColor, var(--icon-button-background-active-color));
  background-color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 0.135);
  background-color: var(--iconButtonBackgroundActiveColorNoBackground, var(--icon-button-background-active-color-no-background));
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button:not(:last-child) {
  margin-right: .25em;
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button:hover {
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  border: var(--icon-button-border-color, var(--icon-button-background-hover-color));
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
  background-color: var(--iconButtonBackgroundHoverColor, var(--icon-button-background-hover-color));
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button:active {
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  border: var(--icon-button-border-color, var(--icon-button-background-hover-color));
  background-color: rgba(36, 42, 56, 0.12);
  background-color: var(--iconButtonBackgroundActiveColor, var(--icon-button-background-active-color));
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button__icon {
  top: -.1em;
  right: -.1em;
  height: 1.3em;
  width: 1.3em;
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button__icon--s2b {
  width: 1.7em;
  height: 1.7em;
  top: -1px;
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button__icon--s2 {
  width: 1.9em;
  height: 1.9em;
  top: -1px;
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button__icon--s3 {
  width: 2.2em;
  height: 2.2em;
  top: 0;
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button__icon--app-floating {
  width: 3.2em;
  height: 3.2em;
  top: 0;
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button__icon--app-square {
  width: 3.5em;
  height: 3.5em;
  top: 0;
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button__icon--launchpad-s1 {
  width: auto;
  height: 3.2em;
  top: 0;
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button__icon--launchpad-s1b {
  width: auto;
  height: 2.8em;
  top: 0;
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button__icon--launchpad-s2 {
  width: 3.2em;
  height: auto;
  top: 0;
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button--move {
  background-color: transparent;
  color: white;
  opacity: 0.5;
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button--move:visited {
  color: var(--fontColorDark);
  text-decoration: none;
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button--move:hover {
  background-color: transparent;
  border-color: transparent;
  color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  opacity: 0.8;
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button--move:hover,
.gw-launchpad-icon-button--move:focus {
  text-decoration: none;
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button--move:active {
  background-color: transparent;
  color: var(--fontColorDark);
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button--move>.gw-launchpad-icon-button__icon {
  height: 17px;
  width: 17px;
}

.gw-launchpad-icon-button--selected {

Welcome to Essex

Search

Cost of living support

Get support with bills including energy, broadband and food costs. 

Help with the cost of living

Our services

Adult social care and health

Includes social care help, advice on disabilities and health conditions, Blue Badge, paying for care and support for carers

Children, young people and families

Find services for children and young people, including social care, adoption, fostering and health and wellbeing

Schools and learning

Includes school admissions, early years and childcare, post-16 options and adult learning

Jobs and apprenticeships

Find jobs, volunteering and apprenticeship opportunities in Essex

Births, ceremonies and deaths

Includes weddings, civil partnerships, births, deaths, Coroner's service, citizenship and other ceremonies

Libraries

Reserve, renew and access library items. Find events and volunteering opportunities.

Roads, streets and transport

Report a highways problem, get updates on travel, transport and roadworks

Planning, land and recycling

Includes planning applications, recycling centres and Essex Energy Switch

Business

Includes business licences, supplying the council, trading standards and support for businesses

About the council

Find your councillor, Council Tax, what happens at council meetings and how the council works

Leisure, culture and local heritage

Includes cultural events and activities, historical records, archives and building conservation

Make a payment

Pay social care and sundry invoices, penalty charges and licence fees

Pothole repair schedule? We're on it.

A properly repaired road means one less thing to look out for, making journeys in Essex a little easier. We’ve teamed up with Essex Highways to keep you updated on the Pothole Emergency Programme.

Our dedicated site gives more information about the Pothole Emergency, lets you track progress across the county, and see scheduled pothole repairs in your area.

Responsible use of your data
We and our 1089 partners process your personal data, e.g. your IP-number, using technology such as cookies to store and access information on your device in order to serve personalized ads and content, ad and content measurement, audience research and services development. You have a choice in who uses your data and for what purposes. Your privacy choices are only applicable on this digital property where you have made your choices. You can change or withdraw your consent any time from the Cookie Declaration or by clicking on the Privacy trigger icon.

If you allow, we would also like to:

  • Identify your device by actively scanning it for specific characteristics (fingerprinting)

We use cookies to personalise content and ads, to provide social media features and to analyse our traffic. We also share information about your use of our site with our social media, advertising and analytics partners who may combine it with other information that you’ve provided to them or that they’ve collected from your use of their services.

About Ad Settings
We and our 1089 advertising partners process your personal data using technology such as cookies in order to serve advertising, analyse our traffic and deliver customised experiences for you. You have a choice in who uses your data and for what purposes.
Some partners do not ask for your consent to process your data, instead, they rely on their legitimate business interest. View our list of partners to see the purposes they believe they have legitimate interest for and how you can object to it.
The choices you make regarding the purposes and entities listed are saved in the local storage in 'cookiebotTcfConsentString', for a maximum of 13 months. After up to 13 months, the CMP will prompt again.
You can set your consent preferences and determine how you want your data to be used based on the purposes below. Each purpose has a description so that you know how we and our partners use your data. You can object to legitimate interest processing per purpose.
Purposes11 Reject all Accept all
Cookies, device or similar online identifiers (e.g. login-based identifiers, randomly assigned identifiers, network based identifiers) together with other information (e.g. browser type and information, language, screen size, supported technologies etc.) can be stored or read on your device to recognise it each time it connects to an app or to a website, for one or several of the purposes presented here.
    Examples:
  • Most purposes explained in this notice rely on the storage or accessing of information from your device when you use an app or visit a website. For example, a vendor or publisher might need to store a cookie on your device during your first visit on a website, to be able to recognise your device during your next visits (by accessing this cookie each time).

Vendors 858

Advertising presented to you on this service can be based on limited data, such as the website or app you are using, your non-precise location, your device type or which content you are (or have been) interacting with (for example, to limit the number of times an ad is presented to you).
    Examples:
  • A car manufacturer wants to promote its electric vehicles to environmentally conscious users living in the city after office hours. The advertising is presented on a page with related content (such as an article on climate change actions) after 6:30 p.m. to users whose non-precise location suggests that they are in an urban zone.
  • A large producer of watercolour paints wants to carry out an online advertising campaign for its latest watercolour range, diversifying its audience to reach as many amateur and professional artists as possible and avoiding showing the ad next to mismatched content (for instance, articles about how to paint your house). About
Cookies are small text files that can be used by websites to make a user's experience more efficient.

The law states that we can store cookies on your device if they are strictly necessary for the operation of this site. For all other types of cookies we need your permission.

This site uses different types of cookies. Some cookies are placed by third party services that appear on our pages.

You can at any time change or withdraw your consent from the Cookie Declaration on our website.

Learn more about who we are, how you can contact us and how we process personal data in our Privacy Policy.

Services

Benefits and financial help

Housing Benefit, Universal Credit, Discretionary Housing Payments, Council Tax reduction and how to let us know about a change of circumstances.

Bins, recycling and street cleaning

Report missed bins and find recycling centres. Includes information on bin collections, recycling, street cleaning, business and commercial waste. How to dispose of hazardous waste.

Births, deaths and marriages

Register births, marriages, deaths and stillbirths. Information about civil partnerships and ceremonies, births, registration certificates, approved wedding premises licences.

Business and licensing

Includes information about business rates, business support, food businesses, health and safety, licensing, markets and Trading Standards.

Council Tax

Pay council tax, who needs to pay, how your Council Tax is calculated, how to apply for a discount or an exemption and Council Tax for second homes and empty homes.

Health and social care

Adult social care, care services, children and families, public health, adoption, fostering, cost of living, care leavers, adult safeguarding, safeguarding children.

Housing

Homelessness, affordable housing, council housing and leaseholders, housing support and grants, private tenants, private landlords, empty homes and community-led housing.
 

Libraries and archives

Find and join a library, borrow and reserve books, research local studies and online resources in Westmorland and Furness libraries.

Parking, streets and transport

Report issues and find information on roads, pavements, and parking in our area. Information on bus services and community travel schemes.

Parks, culture and leisure

Parks, gardens, trees and countryside, leisure and sports facilities, museums and galleries, what's on and events.

Planning and building control

Find planning applications and how to make a planning application. Information on building control, conservation, minerals and waste planning and local land charges.

Schools and education

School term dates, school places, early help, free school meals, school transport, courses for adults.

Voting and elections

Includes voting, elections, electoral registration and election results.

Your council

Includes information on councillors, meetings, agendas, councillors, committees, finances, job vacancies and consultations.

Your environment

Includes nuisances, pests, dogs, climate change, emergency planning, and private water supplies. Information about area locality boards and community safety, funding and assets.

SKDC statement on Modern Slavery

Under the Modern Slavery Act 2015, SKDC is required to notify the Home Office about any potential victims of modern slavery we encounter.

Officers may not be aware they are being trafficked or exploited, and may have consented to elements of their exploitation, Cases are referred via the National Referral Mechanism to be fully considered, even where we cannot be certain that someone is a victim.
(Safeguarding Policy and Procedures 2024-27)

Got a question? Ask AVA: Check out our new chatbot​

Got a question? Ask AVA: Check out our new chatbot​

South Staffordshire Council is proud to announce the launch of its new digital assistant - a smart, interactive chatbot designed to make accessing council services faster, easier, and more convenient for residents.​
All news
Image

‘A loss of local democracy’: Council leader calls for urgent review of new ‘one size fits all’ planning legislation

The leader of South Staffordshire Council has today written to the Government calling for an urgent review of new national legislation which she says will result in ‘a loss of local democracy’.
Image

South Staffs the only UK council to win 2026 national training award

South Staffordshire Council has secured prestigious national recognition for its employee development programmes – positioning it as the only UK council to receive a 2026 Princess Royal Training Award.
Image

Cemetery events bring communities together

Residents of all ages joined councillors and officers in enjoying two successful ‘Birds and Bulbs’ events at Sytch Lane Cemetery, Wombourne, and Strawberry Lane Cemetery, Great Wyrley, delivered in partnership with Forest of Mercia CIC.
Image

Tributes to be paid to district Labour leader Councillor Jeff Ashley

Revered Labour leader for South Staffordshire, Councillor Jeff Ashley, will be paid tribute to by his fellow members this evening at Full Council, following his death earlier this month.

document.addEventListener("copy", (e) => {
  const sel = window.getSelection?.();
  if (!sel || sel.isCollapsed) return;

  const text = sel.toString();

  // Entire selection must be an email followed by a single trailing dot
  const match = text.match(
    /^([A-Z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z]{2,})\.$/i
  );

  if (!match || !e.clipboardData) {
    return; // normal browser copy
  }

  e.preventDefault();
  e.clipboardData.setData("text/plain", match[1]);
});
</script>

/** Button
  ---------------------------------------------------------*/
.gw-launchpad-button-outlined {
  background-color: transparent;
  border-color: var(--defaultColor);
  color: var(--fontColorDark);
  /**
           * @Full Width
           */
}

.gw-launchpad-button-outlined:visited {
  color: var(--fontColorDark);
  text-decoration: none;
}

.gw-launchpad-button-outlined:hover {
  border-color: var(--defaultColorHover);
  background-color: var(--defaultColorHover);
  color: var(--fontColorDark);
}

.gw-launchpad-button-outlined:active {
  border-color: var(--defaultColorActive);
  background-color: var(--defaultColorActive);
  color: var(--fontColorDark);
}

.gw-launchpad-button-outlined--primary {
  background-color: transparent;
  color: var(--fontColorDark);
  border: #006fe6;
  border: var(--primaryButtonBorder, var(--primaryButtonBorder));
  border-radius: 30px;
  border-radius: var(--buttonBorderRadius, var(--buttonBorderRadius));
}

.gw-launchpad-button-outlined--primary:visited {
  color: var(--fontColorDark);
  text-decoration: none;
}

.gw-launchpad-button-outlined--primary:hover {
  background-color: #0056b3;
  background-color: var(--primaryButtonBackgroundHoverColor, var(--primaryColorHover));
  border: 2px solid #0056b3;
  border: var(--primaryButtonBorderHover, var(--primaryButtonBorderHover));
  color: var(--fontColorWhite);
}

.gw-launchpad-button-outlined--primary:active {
  border: 2px solid #0056b3;
  border: var(--primaryButtonBorderHover, var(--primaryButtonBorderHover));
  background-color: #003e80;

  color: white;

.gw-launchpad-button {
  position: relative;

  font-family: "Open Sans", Arial, sans-serif;

  padding: 10px 20px;

  -ms-user-select: none;
  user-select: none;
  overflow: visible;
  text-decoration: none;
  -webkit-transition: background-color ease-in-out 0.06s;
  transition: background-color ease-in-out 0.06s;
  -webkit-transform: none;
  transform: none;
  line-height: 1.4;
  -webkit-transition: color .10s ease-in-out, background-color .10s ease-in-out, border-color .10s ease-in-out, -webkit-box-shadow .10s ease-in-out;

  transition: color .10s ease-in-out, background-color .10s ease-in-out, border-color .10s ease-in-out, box-shadow .10s ease-in-out;

  cursor: pointer;
  background-color: #d5d6d7;
  background-color: var(--defaultColor, var(--defaultColor));
  color: black;

  border: 2px solid #d5d6d7;
  border: var(--buttonBorder, var(--buttonBorderColor));
  border-radius: 30px;
  border-radius: var(--buttonBorderRadius, var(--buttonBorderRadius));

  /**

  <script>
  (function() {
    let chatbotHasInit = false;

    const styleOptions = {
      transitionDuration: '0s',
      hideUploadButton: true,
      hideTelephoneKeypadButton: true,
      bubbleBackground: '#F0F0F0',
      bubbleBorderColor: '#FFFFFF',
      bubbleBorderRadius: 12,
      bubbleBorderWidth: 0,
      bubbleNubOffset: 0,
      bubbleNubSize: 10,
      bubbleFromUserBackground: '#F8EEF8',
      bubbleFromUserBorderColor: '#F8EEF8',
      bubbleFromUserBorderRadius: 12,
      bubbleFromUserBorderWidth: 2,
      bubbleFromUserNubOffset: 0,
      bubbleFromUserNubSize: 10,
      bubbleFromUserTextColor: 'Black',
      bubbleMaxWidth: '85%',
      avatarBorderRadius: '50%',
      avatarSize: 40,
      botAvatarBackgroundColor: '#880088',
      botAvatarImage: '/themes/contrib/localgov_base_croydon/assets/img/robot-outline.svg',
      botAvatarInitials: 'CC',
      showAvatarInGroup: 'status',
      connectivityTextSize: '75%',
      failedConnectivity: '#C50F1F',
      slowConnectivity: '#EAA300',
      notificationText: '#5E5E5E',
      slowConnectionAfter: 15000,
      emojiSet: true,
      hideSendBox: false,
      microphoneButtonColorOnDictate: '#F33',
      sendBoxBackground: '#FFFFFF',
      uploadMultiple: true,
      sendAttachmentOn: 'send',
      sendBoxButtonColor: '#FFFFFF',
      sendBoxButtonShadeColor: '#77bb55',
      sendBoxButtonColorOnActive: '#121212',
      sendBoxButtonShadeColorOnActive: '#FFBB00',
      sendBoxButtonColorOnDisabled: '#FFFFFF',
      sendBoxButtonShadeColorOnDisabled: '#A0A0A0',
      sendBoxButtonColorOnFocus: '#121212',
      sendBoxButtonShadeColorOnFocus: '#FFBB00',
      sendBoxButtonColorOnHover: '#FFFFFF',
      sendBoxButtonShadeColorOnHover: '#540055',
      sendBoxButtonShadeBorderRadius: 0,
      sendBoxButtonShadeInset: 2,
      sendBoxButtonKeyboardFocusIndicatorBorderColor: '#FFBB00',
      sendBoxButtonKeyboardFocusIndicatorBorderRadius: 0,
      sendBoxButtonKeyboardFocusIndicatorBorderStyle: 'solid',
      sendBoxButtonKeyboardFocusIndicatorBorderWidth: 2,
      sendBoxButtonKeyboardFocusIndicatorInset: 0,
      sendBoxDisabledTextColor: '#FFFFFF',
      sendBoxHeight: 40,
      sendBoxMaxHeight: 200,
      sendBoxTextColor: 'Black',
      scrollToEndButtonBehavior: false,
      autoScrollSnapOnActivity: true,
      autoScrollSnapOnActivityOffset: 1,
      autoScrollSnapOnPage: false,
      autoScrollSnapOnPageOffset: 1
    };

    async function initChatbot(webchat) {
      if (chatbotHasInit) {
        return;
      }

      chatbotHasInit = true;

      const TOKEN_URL = new URL("https://chat.croydon.gov.uk/powervirtualagents/botsbyschema/cr578_agent/directline/token?api-version=2022-03-01-preview");
      const locale = document.documentElement.lang || "en";
      const apiVersion = TOKEN_URL.searchParams.get("api-version");

      try {
        const [directLineURL, token] = await Promise.all([
          fetch(new URL(`/powervirtualagents/regionalchannelsettings?api-version=${apiVersion}`, TOKEN_URL))
            .then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : Promise.reject("Failed to retrieve regional channel settings."))
            .then(({channelUrlsById: {directline}}) => directline),
          fetch(TOKEN_URL)
            .then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : Promise.reject("Failed to retrieve Direct Line token."))
            .then(({token}) => token)
        ]);

        const directLine = WebChat.createDirectLine({
          domain: new URL("v3/directline", directLineURL),
          token
        });

        const subscription = directLine.connectionStatus$.subscribe({
          next(value) {
            if (value === 2) {
              directLine.postActivity({
                localTimezone: Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone,
                locale,
                name: "startConversation",
                type: "event"
              }).subscribe();
              subscription.unsubscribe();
            }
          }
        });

        window.WebChat.renderWebChat({directLine, locale, styleOptions}, webchat);

        // Android keyboard fix: scroll input into view when focused
        setTimeout(() => {
          const sendBoxInput = webchat.querySelector('.webchat__send-box-text-box__input');
          if (sendBoxInput) {
            sendBoxInput.addEventListener('focus', function() {
              setTimeout(() => {
                this.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
              }, 300);
            });
          }
        }, 1000);

      } catch (error) {
        webchat.innerHTML = '<div style="padding: 20px; text-align: center; color: #C50F1F;">Unable to start chat. Please refresh the page and try again.</div>';
      }
    }

    const chatContainer = document.querySelector(".js-chatbot__chat-container");
    const chatbuttonContainer = document.querySelector(".chatbot-button__container");
    const chatContent = document.querySelector(".js-chatbot__chat-content");
    const chatMin = document.querySelector(".chatbot__min");

    function waitAndFocus(maxAttempts = 20, interval = 200) {
      let attempts = 0;

      const tryFocus = () => {
        attempts++;
        const markdown = document.querySelector(".webchat__render-markdown");
        const sendBox = document.querySelector(".webchat__send-box-text-box__input");

        if (markdown) {
          markdown.focus();
          return true;
        } else if (sendBox) {
          sendBox.focus();
          return true;
        } else if (attempts < maxAttempts) {
          setTimeout(tryFocus, interval);
        }
      };

      setTimeout(tryFocus, 300);
    }

    // Attach open handler to all open buttons
    document.querySelectorAll(".js-chatbot__open-button").forEach(button => {
      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        chatContainer.style.display = "flex";
        chatbuttonContainer.style.display = "none";
        initChatbot(chatContent);
        waitAndFocus();
      });
    });

    // Attach terminate handler to all terminate buttons
    document.querySelectorAll(".js-chatbot__terminate-button").forEach(button => {
      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        if (confirm('Are you sure you want to close and delete all chat messages?')) {
          window.location.reload();
        }
      });
    });

    // Attach minimise handler to all minimise buttons
    document.querySelectorAll(".js-chatbot__minimise-button").forEach(button => {
      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        chatContainer.style.display = "none";
        chatbuttonContainer.style.display = "flex";
      });
    });

    if (chatMin) {
      chatMin.addEventListener("click", () => {
        chatbuttonContainer.classList.add("chatbot__min-toggle");
        chatMin.style.display = 'none';

        try {
          sessionStorage.setItem('chatbotMinimised', 'true');
        } catch (e) {}
      });
    }

    function loadChatbotState() {
      try {
        if (sessionStorage.getItem('chatbotMinimised') === 'true') {
          chatbuttonContainer.classList.add("chatbot__min-toggle");
          chatMin.style.display = 'none';
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    loadChatbotState();

    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
      if (!document.hidden && chatContainer.style.display === 'flex') {
        waitAndFocus(5, 500);
      }
    });
  })();
</script>
